newsitem.title: USA: Capital Apartment reviewing Dominium proxy.
newsitem.headline: Capital Apartment reviewing Dominium proxy.

text.p: Capital Apartment Properties Inc (CAPREIT) said Thursday its attornies are reviewing the proxy filed by Dominium Tax Exempt Fund LLP attacking the proposed merger of Capital Apartment with Capital Realty Investors Tax Exempt Fund LP, Series I, II and III.

Capital Apartment president Richard Kadish stated, "This is obviously a last ditch attempt on the part of Dominium to stop a transaction as to which they were unwilling and incapable of coming to the table with a better price for (the three funds') holders, notwithstanding an eight month opportunity to do so."
Kadish further commented, "Our attorneys are currently reviewing this matter."
